title: Store Nav
description: The top bar of a store, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Menu, Combobox, Drawer, Button, Badge, Alert and Skeleton primitives: the brand as a link home, the categories (plain links, and a Menu for a category with sub-categories), a product search that suggests products as you type and searches on Enter, and a cart button with its item count, with its own loading, empty and error renders for the categories; responds to its container (@container) — below @md the categories collapse into a right Drawer opened from a Menu button, and the search sits on its own row until @lg, where it joins the bar.
